method: Static source, structured cleave facts, decoded Base64 JSON, atomscan slow scans, positive malware controls and benign near misses. Samples were never executed.
scope: Verdicts apply to the supplied files. The JavaScript bundled native runtime was not supplied; its behavior is not inferred from configuration strings.

samples.identification_and_evidence: UDP rendezvous data selects a TCP peer; received bytes reach os.system. Copies init records and bind-mounts them over its procfs directory.
samples.marker_summary: UDP command backdoor: tighten masking; relocate shell observations

samples.identification_and_evidence: Decodes an HTTP header into shell_exec, encodes output, and sends a 404. CLI mode enables PHP on .deb files, restarts httpd, and sets SUID on /bin/sh.
samples.marker_summary: PHP header webshell: classify Apache handler configuration neutrally

samples.identification_and_evidence: Exports launch helpers for a bundled platform binary. Passes an encoded configuration, event text, and registry tokens; supplies fallback CA roots. No credential export or replication is implemented in the supplied source.
samples.marker_summary: Cloud OpenClaw launcher: remove unproven theft and worm claims

placement_and_detection_changes: Shell execution observations moved from system to shell/command-mode; exact references and directory selectors audited.
Socket/shell co-occurrence moved out of backdoor classification; hostile channel rules retain init-metadata masking context.
Procfs masking requires copied init metadata; an init path mention alone is insufficient.
Generic Apache PHP handler configuration moved out of webshell classification; the bare handler umbrella was removed.
Registry-token read plus detached native launch is a notable capability combination, not proof of theft.
SCKIT configuration schema, environment option, and hostname observations moved to neutral homes; unsupported JavaScript family verdicts removed.
Encoded JSON presence moved from encoding-operation detection to file encoding metadata.
PEM paths no longer imply secret keys; hidden .key path observation moved from bearer tokens to extension paths. Token-category conjunctions no longer accept key paths as tokens.
CA bundle and TLS certificate directory references are notable.
The subprocess umbrella now selects subprocess APIs; unrelated shell and exec mechanisms no longer mislabel subprocess use.
